mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${table} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, preset_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, core_size INT NOT NULL, max_size INT NOT NULL, keep_alive_seconds INT NOT NULL, queue_capacity INT, gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_preset_name (preset_name) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${table} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, pool_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, preset_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, start_cron VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, end_cron VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY idx_window_pool (pool_name) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${table} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, pool_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, preset_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_binding_pool (pool_name) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${table} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, host VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, pool_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, preset_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, old_core INT NOT NULL, old_max INT NOT NULL, old_keep INT NOT NULL, new_core INT NOT NULL, new_max INT NOT NULL, new_keep INT NOT NULL, old_queue INT, new_queue INT, gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY idx_audit_pool_time (pool_name, occurred_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (id, preset_name, core_size, max_size, keep_alive_seconds, queue_capacity, gmt_create) VALUES (#{seq}, #{row.presetName}, #{row.coreSize}, #{row.maxSize}, #{row.keepAliveSeconds}, #{row.queueCapacity}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE core_size = VALUES(core_size), max_size = VALUES(max_size), keep_alive_seconds = VALUES(keep_alive_seconds), queue_capacity = VALUES(queue_capacity)
mapper.select: SELECT preset_name, core_size, max_size, keep_alive_seconds, queue_capacity FROM ${table} WHERE preset_name = #{name}
SELECT preset_name, core_size, max_size, keep_alive_seconds, queue_capacity FROM ${table} ORDER BY preset_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (id, pool_name, preset_name, gmt_create) VALUES (#{seq}, #{poolName}, #{presetName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE preset_name = VALUES(preset_name)
INSERT INTO ${table} (id, pool_name, preset_name, start_cron, end_cron, gmt_create) VALUES (#{id}, #{w.poolName}, #{w.presetName}, #{w.startCron}, #{w.endCron}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO ${table} (id, occurred_at, host, pool_name, preset_name, source, old_core, old_max, old_keep, new_core, new_max, new_keep, old_queue, new_queue, gmt_create) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.occurredAt}, #{row.host}, #{row.poolName}, #{row.presetName}, #{row.source}, #{row.oldCore}, #{row.oldMax}, #{row.oldKeep}, #{row.newCore}, #{row.newMax}, #{row.newKeep}, #{row.oldQueue}, #{row.newQueue}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ${table} WHERE occurred_at < #{threshold} LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT CAST(GREATEST( COALESCE((SELECT MAX(gmt_modified) FROM ${presetTable}), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(gmt_modified) FROM ${windowTable}), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(gmt_modified) FROM ${bindingTable}), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(gmt_modified) FROM ${auditTable}), '1970-01-01') ) AS CHAR)
